data.creator_notes:
Here is a singular character card tutorial, please feel free to also use this as a template and modify as you please.

In some instances it is just better to retry a response form AI due to its unpredictable nature, so faults are likely to happen, but sometimes all you gotta do it turn it off then on again, or in this case: Retry.

Mentioning that, not all cards are poorly made, and AI can just be doing its AI things and funking up.

I will create another for multiple characters and finally one for randomly generated worlds/realms as well as one for RPG type RPs with stats, but I will be slow. (I really enjoy the last type of RP bots though, very engaging and enjoyable, like the Town of Sodom, if the creator of that sees this, I BEG YOU TO PLEASE MAKE MORE!)

Use {{char}} to apply things to the ai, in chat the {{char}} text will turn into the in-chat name, this one being "Hrng..."

Same goes for {{user}}, use it to apply the user's actions to them, example {{user}} backs up. This will however put the RP in 3rd person in some instances, but you can define that in the ai description with {POV: (First person.)} Although AI can be finicky, sometimes you just have to use a different model, Gemini is okay, I'd say.

{Personality: (Blahblahblah + yadayadayada)} text like that with brackets helps the AI highlight its traits, I think? Every AI I've used had worked better with these, regardless.
